title: “World Famous” Hippocrates Green Juice Recipe!
excerpt: You could say we are a little crazy about our green juice here at Hippocrates. We drink it twice a day and believe our recipe offers the perfect balance of nutrients and flavor.
content:
Ingredients

  • For 16 oz of deliciously fresh green juice, you’ll need:
  • 1 to 1 ½ organic cucumbers or about 1 lb. (to get you about 8 oz)
  • 2 stalks organic celery (leaves and all) (to get you about 2 oz)
  • 1 hefty handful organic sunflower sprouts (to get you about 3 oz)
  • 1 hefty handful of organic pea sprouts (to get you about 3 oz)

Method

  1. Juice the ingredients and enjoy right away!
  2. Make your green juice even more energy packed by adding Blue Green Algae or Spirulina!
  3. Feel free to experiment with additional herbs and greens to make it your own.
